lan.applied: The other device confirmed and imported it
lan.wrongCode: Wrong pairing code. Check the code on the other screen (it changes after a few wrong tries).
lan.rejected: The other device declined or did not confirm in time
lan.busy: The other device is busy with another sync. Try again later.
lan.unsupported: The other version cannot receive v4 data (3.x only receives 3.x data). Use a backup file or WebDAV instead.
lan.unreachable: Cannot reach the other device. Check that both are on the same network, it is receiving, and the address and port are right.
lan.failed: The other device failed to import
lan.networkNote:
From Android 17 the system may ask to allow the Local network / Nearby devices permission; if the devices cannot connect, allow it under Settings › Apps › Pure Live › Permissions.
Windows shows a firewall prompt the first time it receives; allow access on private networks.
Both devices need to be on the same Wi-Fi (or local network).
lan.enterAddress: Enter the address shown on the other screen, for example 192.168.1.5:39888
lan.enterCode: Enter the 6-digit pairing code shown on the other screen
lan.receiveHint: Start receiving on the device that gets the data, then enter the address and pairing code shown here under Send on the other device. You confirm before anything is written.
lan.noAddress: No local network address found. Connect to Wi-Fi first.
lan.codeOnce: A pairing code works once: it changes after one transfer or a few wrong tries.
lan.qrHint: 3.x can scan this QR code to send data
lan.sendHint: First open LAN sync › Receive on the other device, then enter the address and pairing code it shows. Send a full backup or follows only; platform sign-ins are only sent, encrypted, when you set a passphrase.

error.forbidden: This account cannot access that location
error.notFound: The file or folder does not exist on the server
error.network: Cannot reach the server. Check the address and network.
error.invalid: The server's reply is not WebDAV. Check the address.

webdav.noDirectory: The folder does not exist yet; the first upload creates it
webdav.connectedNoDirectory: Connected; the backup folder does not exist yet and the first upload creates it
webdav.deleteAccountConfirm: Delete "{name}" and its saved password? Backups on the server are not affected.
webdav.noAccountsHint: Add Jianguoyun, Nextcloud, Synology or another WebDAV drive to keep backups in the cloud.
webdav.remoteFilesHint: Tap a file to restore or delete it; 3.x purelive_*.txt backups can be restored too
webdav.helpBody:
Jianguoyun: use https://dav.jianguoyun.com/dav/, your sign-in email as the user name, and an app password generated under Account info › Security options.

Nextcloud / ownCloud: use https://your-domain/remote.php/dav/files/username/.

Synology: install WebDAV Server from the Package Center and use https://nas-address:5006/.

Alist and similar: usually https://domain/dav/.

The backup folder is pure_live by default and is created by the first upload. Passwords are stored encrypted on this device and never go into regular backups.
webdav.nameTaken: An account with this name exists
webdav.badUrl: The address must start with http:// or https:// and cannot contain a user name, query or #
webdav.directoryRoot: Leave empty for the root folder
